12. If the person making the statement cannot read, or refuses to read it, or to write the above
mentioned certificate at the end of it or to sign it, the person taking the statement shall read it
to them and ask them if they would like to correct, alter or add anything and to put their
signature or make their mark at the end. The person taking the statement shall certify on the
statement itself what has occurred.
